name: Pasea Hotel & Spa
insider_take: Pasea Hotel & Spa sits directly on Huntington Beach's famous "Surf City USA" coastline, where you can watch world-class surfers tackle the legendary waves just steps from your oceanfront room.
whats_special: This boutique hotel features the largest rooftop pool deck in Huntington Beach, offering panoramic ocean views. The property's indigenous name "Pasea" means "to take a leisurely walk," perfectly capturing the laid-back California beach vibe. The hotel's spa uses locally-sourced sea salt and marine botanicals in treatments.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the rooftop Treehouse restaurant during golden hour – the unobstructed Pacific views and craft cocktails create the perfect SoCal evening experience.
dont_miss: The famous Huntington Pier is just a 5-minute walk away, home to the US Open of Surfing each summer. Explore Main Street's eclectic mix of surf shops, art galleries, and farm-to-table restaurants. The hotel offers complimentary beach cruiser bikes to explore the 22-mile coastal bike path.
pros: Prime beachfront location with direct beach access
Full-service spa with wellness treatments and amenities
Modern luxury accommodations with ocean views
Multiple dining options and rooftop experiences
cons: Premium pricing for beachfront luxury positioning
Limited parking availability during peak seasons
